design_detail: Piketty proposal for a global progressive wealth tax
quote_original: Ekonomistas ir sociologas Romas Lazutka teigia, kad prancūzų ekonomisto pasiūlymas įvesti pasaulinį turto mokestį geras, tačiau kyla viena problema – pasaulyje nėra bendros valdžios.
quote_en: Economist and sociologist Romas Lazutka says the French economist’s proposal for a global wealth tax is good, but there is one problem: there is no global government.
source_title: Pagal turtinės nelygybės mastą Europoje Lietuva nusileidžia tik Portugalijai
grading_note: Contemporaneous news report attributes a positive assessment to Lazutka; this sentence is reported speech, not a direct quotation. He notes the absence of global government as a practical obstacle.
